sum: Regis Corporation owns and franchises hair care salons primarily in North America. The company operates in two segments: Franchise Salons and Company-Owned Salons. Its salons provide haircutting; styling, including shampooing and conditioning; and hair coloring, as well as sell various hair care and other beauty products. It also offers business performance coaching, stylist training and education, site approval, marketing, loyalty and CRM programs, and technology support. The company operates its salons primarily under Supercuts, SmartStyle, Cost Cutters, First Choice Haircutters, Roosters, Hair Masters, Magicuts, Holiday Hair, and Regis concept names. Regis Corporation was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
